conditions: The definitions are ordinary examples of delayed or immediate assignment evaluated as documented.
limitations: Matching and evaluation of left-hand arguments, held expressions that do not invoke a definition, and explicit evaluation controls have separate treatment.

triggers: Publisher correction, archive byte drift, or contrary evidence about the exact 14.3 reference.

statement: The Wolfram Language 14.3 reference describes SetDelayed as retaining a definition's right-hand expression unevaluated and evaluating it afresh when the definition is used. Its immediate-definition example evaluates the right-hand side when the definition is made.
